stem.en: A patient has a stenotic aortic valve, obstructing blood flow out of the left ventricle. What adaptive change would this most directly cause in the left ventricle?
stem.et: Patsiendil on stenootiline aordiklapp, mis takistab verevoolu vasakust vatsakesest välja. Millist adaptiivset muutust põhjustaks see kõige otsesemalt vasakus vatsakeses?

label.en: Hypertrophy of the ventricular wall, as the chamber generates higher pressure to push blood through the narrowed valve opening.
label.et: Vatsakese seina hüpertroofia, kuna kamber tekitab kõrgemat rõhku, et suruda verd läbi ahenenud klapiava.

label.en: Dilation of the chamber to accommodate extra leaking blood volume, the same response seen with a regurgitant valve.
label.et: Kambri dilatatsioon, et mahutada lisa lekkivat vere mahtu, sama reaktsioon, mida näeb regurgiteeruva klapi puhul.

label.en: The chamber would enlarge without thickening its wall, since all valve-related stress produces the same enlargement response.
label.et: Kamber suureneks ilma oma seina paksenemata, kuna igasugune klapiga seotud stress tekitab sama suurenemise reaktsiooni.

label.en: This would have the same effect on the right atrium as it would on the left ventricle, since the specific valve involved doesn't change which chamber is burdened.
label.et: See mõjutaks parem koda samamoodi nagu vasakut vatsakest, kuna konkreetne kaasatud klapp ei muuda seda, milline kamber on koormatud.
